resources.string: A local-first coding workspace with streaming AI, guarded tools, file checkpoints, and real Git. Inspired by the mobile coding workflow of Aicode-Glass; independently implemented.
The AI wants to change this workspace file. Review the proposed content. A checkpoint is created only if you approve. Rejecting sends a denial back to the model.
This version does not include Linux, SSH, a background execution service, MCP, or autonomous Git pushes. Agent requests run while the app process is alive. Keep the app open during long replies.
Automatic snapshots before AI edits, editor saves, terminal mutations, and imports. The latest 30 are retained per workspace. Rollback restores files, not chats or Git metadata.
No uncommitted changes. Edit a file or ask AI to propose a change.
Add your API key in Settings. Chat with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or an OpenAI-compatible HTTPS endpoint.
This removes the conversation and its tool history. Workspace files are not changed.
Your unsaved editor changes will be lost. Saved files and checkpoints are unaffected.
UTF-8 · syntax highlighting · 1 MB limit · saves create checkpoints
Create a file or import a ZIP. Your files stay in private app storage.
Pull is fast-forward only and requires a clean worktree. Push sends the current local branch to origin after confirmation. It never force-pushes. Set a token in Settings for private repositories.
Initialize a real local Git repository. Stage files, commit changes, switch branches, and inspect diffs without leaving your phone.
Real Git. Clear changes. Your history.
A thoughtful space to write code, collaborate with AI, and keep every experiment reversible.
No key saved for this provider
A key is securely saved on this device
Keys use device-bound Android Keystore AES-GCM encryption. They are sent only to the selected provider and are excluded from backups and workspace exports. Provider billing and data policies apply.
Create a snapshot now, or let the editor and AI create one automatically before changes.
Stage a file and make your first commit.

No analytics or app-operated backend. Prompts, conversation context, and approved tool reads go directly to your selected AI provider. Do not put secrets in workspace files. Uninstalling removes private app data; export important work first.
Local workspace · approval-gated edits · your API keys
Explain a file in my workspace
Plan a small project with me
Review my code and suggest improvements
Choose a protocol, enter a model ID, and save your own key. Custom uses the OpenAI chat-completions protocol.
Push the current branch “%1$s” to origin? This uploads committed local code to the configured remote. It will not force-push.
HTTPS only. Never embed a token in the URL. Use the separate token field in Settings.
Remove the saved key for this provider from this device?
Remove the saved GitHub token from this device?
Replace current workspace files with this snapshot? A safety checkpoint is created first. Unsaved editor content is discarded. Git metadata and chats are preserved.
A safe workspace simulation, not a Linux container. Built-in file commands work; Python, npm, shell scripts, and native binaries do not.
For a private repository, grant only the required repository Contents read/write permission. The token is encrypted on this device and never included in the remote URL.
ZIP import replaces workspace files after a checkpoint. .git is preserved. Limits: 1 MB per file, 64 MB total, 4,000 files. No symlinks.
Each workspace has separate files, conversations, checkpoints, and Git history. Stop AI before switching.
